subject: Re: Solo Connect SDK + Redwood runtime pilot proposal
messages:
From: Nadia Rossi <nadia@solo-connect.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro & proposal: Solo Connect SDK + Redwood runtime pilot

Hi Rishi,

I'm Nadia, Head of Platform at Solo Connect. We build a lightweight SDK (LangChain-style agent helpers + tracing hooks) that a few ISVs embed to manage model calls and telemetry. We've had a number of customers ask for a 'Run-on-Redwood' option to get the latency/cost benefits you advertise.

We'd love to run a short pilot to validate interoperability: a small integration that exercises your streaming API, trace correlation (we'd expect to send a trace_id per request and capture Redwood route/model metadata), and a reference example for our docs. Success metric: end-to-end demo showing reduced per-token latency for an embedded LangChain-style chain and an attached trace in our observability UI.

Do you have an integration lead we can pair with? We can share a mutual action plan and an initial SOW. Proposed timeline: 3-week pilot starting mid-November.

Thanks,
Nadia Rossi
Head of Platform, Solo Connect
nadia@solo-connect.ai
Attachment: SoloConnect_Integration_OnePager.pdf
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Nadia Rossi <nadia@solo-connect.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro & proposal: Solo Connect SDK + Redwood runtime pilot

Nadia — thanks for the clear ask and the one-pager. Happy to explore. Looping in Marissa (Partnerships) and Ben (Sales) to scope the pilot and surface SOW/credits.

High-level thoughts:
- We can expose a sample route with streaming and trace headers; our SDKs already have a trace hook but we need to validate cross-vendor idempotency for KV cache keys.
- 3-week pilot sounds fine; we usually do a two-week technical integration + one-week validation/demo.
- We'll want a simple mutual action plan and a short MOU for pilot terms (data usage, telemetry retention, demo rights).

Marissa / Ben — can one of you take point on the MAP and draft an MOU? Nadia, could you share the example trace payload and the SDK version you want to test?

Best,
Rishi
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Nadia Rossi <nadia@solo-connect.ai>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro & proposal: Solo Connect SDK + Redwood runtime pilot

Hi Nadia — great to meet you virtually. We're excited about this. Drafting a short mutual action plan now (attached). Quick notes from the tech side:

- Pilot scope: 1) SDK instrumentation to propagate trace_id + user_id, 2) sample chain using streaming generation via Redwood API, 3) validated trace ingestion showing model_id, route, model_variant and latency breakouts.
- Deliverables: MAP spreadsheet (attached), integration checklist (small README), test harness (sample app repo link in Drive).
- Access: We'll provide a temporary pilot API key scoped to the 'connectivity' route. No production data should be used; PII must be masked in test payloads.

I've attached: SoloConnect_Redwood_MutualActionPlan.xlsx and redwood_integration_checklist.md. Please review and confirm timelines. Suggest kickoff Wed 11/10 for engineering sync.

Marissa Cole
Partnerships PM, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SoloConnect_Redwood_MutualActionPlan.xlsx; redwood_integration_checklist.md
From: Nadia Rossi <nadia@solo-connect.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: eng-team@solo-connect.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro & proposal: Solo Connect SDK + Redwood runtime pilot

Thanks Marissa — received the MAP and checklist, looks good. A few questions from our eng lead:

- KV cache: we currently key by user_id + prompt_hash. If Redwood uses a different prefix for route-based caching, will that break our cache warming plan?
- Tracing: we plan to send a trace_id header and attach our span metadata. Will Redwood accept arbitrary trace headers and surface them in the console?
- Data retention: can you confirm default telemetry retention for pilot keys? We need 90 days for debugging.

We'll plan for Wed 11/10 kickoff at 10:00 PT; I'll send a calendar invite. Also attached a short trace sample (trace_sample.json) and pointer to our SDK tag: v2.3.1.

Best,
Nadia
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Nadia Rossi <nadia@solo-connect.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro & proposal: Solo Connect SDK + Redwood runtime pilot

Hi all — quick answers from infra/security: 

- KV cache keys: Redwood's cache is namespaced per-customer and per-route. If you include route name as part of your cache key we should be compatible; we'll share the exact prefix pattern in the integration checklist.
- Tracing headers: we accept x-redwood-trace-id and passthrough arbitrary vendor headers; our console will surface custom attributes attached to spans.
- Retention: by default pilot keys have 30-day telemetry retention; we can set this to 90 days for the pilot under a temporary agreement. We'll add an explicit retention row to the MAP.

Also attaching a draft MOU to capture pilot terms (mou_solo_connect_draft.pdf). If legal is fine, we can sign via DocuSign — I'll add Ben to track credits and commercial terms.

—Laura Bennett
Head of Infrastructure Security, Redwood Inference
Attachment: mou_solo_connect_draft.pdf
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Nadia Rossi <nadia@solo-connect.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Solo Connect SDK + Redwood runtime pilot — kickoff confirmed + MOU

Nadia / team — thanks, all looks good on our side. Confirming:

- Kickoff: Wed 2026-11-10 at 10:00 PT (cal invite sent).
- MOU: we've routed the draft to Legal; pending signatures, we'll provision the pilot API key and 90-day telemetry retention.
- Credits: Redwood will provide up to $5,000 in pilot credits for usage during the pilot. Any overages will be handled via a short-term invoice; we'll flag usage proactively.

Next steps for Nadia: review & sign MOU link (DocuSign) and confirm attendees for the kickoff. Then Marissa will own the MAP updates. Looking forward to a smooth integration.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachment: (calendar invite) Redwood-SoloConnect-Kickoff.ics
